none: PAS CAM-D9E3D6: Roman Coin : An Incomplete Copper-alloy Nummus of Valens, AD364-378
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE] ; D/ [...]S P F AVG

An incomplete copper-alloy nummus of Valens, AD364-378. Mint is Arles, AD364-375, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]S P F AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF III//[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.62g,…
